items.title: Can tech companies learn to love cheaper AI models?
items.description: If those same AI workloads can be handled by cheaper models without affecting quality, it would mean a massive shift in the economics of AI.
items.tldr: AIの品質に影響を与えずに安価なモデルで処理できる場合、AIの経済学に大きな変化がもたらされる可能性がある。

items.title: Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5 is a version of Mythos the public can access today
items.description: Anthropic is releasing Claude Fable 5, its first Mythos-class model available to the public. The model comes with guardrails that block responses in high-risk areas like cybersecurity and biology.

items.title: Apple is embracing the fantasy of AI photo editing
items.description: Apple used to question whether generative AI-powered editing features were worth the risk of distorting our perceptions of the world.
